detail.longDescription: I have an organization repository on GitHub that pulls another organization repository as a submodule. For this, there is a step using actions/create-github-app-token to generate a token that has read permission on the other repository, and this token is then used as the token parameter to actions/checkout . That works well. Now I'd like to set up Dependabot. It's actually not supposed to generate PRs for this submodule, but it performs a clone including submodules anyway, and then falls over because no access token is configured for the submodules. The documentation gives an example using a personal access token, but I haven't found anything on how to generate an app token and use that. Is that possible?
